                                   1                       MEMORANDUM OF POINTS AND AUTHORITIES

                                   2    I.     Relief Requested

                                   3           Plaintiffs petition this Court ex parte to issue a temporary restraining order to enjoin

                                   4    Defendants from enforcing or attempting to enforce any restrictive covenants contained in

                                   5    any employment or independent contractor agreements between any Defendant and Steve.

                                   6    Such relief is appropriate in view of the conduct of Defendants, which filed for arbitration on

                                   7    the same day as Plaintiff filed this lawsuit to obtain injunctive relief. The contract between

                                   8    the parties allows either party to ask a court of competent jurisdiction for injunctive relief.

                                   9    Given that the restrictive covenants violate California law and policy, and given that CG is a

                                   10   California limited liability company seeking to employ Steve, the fundamental rights of

                                   11   Plaintiffs will be violated by any other enforcement of the restrictive covenants and

                                   12   irreparable harm will occur. Therefore, the Court should issue a temporary restraining order
1930 N. ARBOLEDA ROAD, SUITE 200

        MESA, AZ 85213

                                   17   at ¶ 4. Steve also has in-depth knowledge of cross discipline engineering in mission critical
                                   18   infrastructure design. Id., at ¶ 5. Steve has experience managing over fifty employees and
                                   19   growing a company from the ground up. Id., at ¶ 6. Steve is highly reputable in his particular
                                   20   field of professional electrical engineering. Id., at ¶ 7. CG Enterprises Holdings, LLC (“CG”)
                                   21   is a start-up California limited liability company that Steve founded in late 2023. Id., at ¶ 8.
                                   22   Steve wishes to continue his work in mission critical engineering through CG. Id., at ¶ 9.

                                   24   interchangeably, “WSP”), and kW Mission Critical Engineering, d.p.c. (“kW Engineering”)

                                   26   kW. Id., at ¶ 11 and Exhibit A thereto. WSP is a large publicly traded New York corporation
